event_name: Date 04 July 2021 Time 16:10 2021 AUSTRIAN GRAND PRIX 01 - 04 July 2021 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Overtaking during a safety car period.
offence: Breach of Article 39.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, positioning and timing data. While the safety car was deployed, GIO went to the pits passing ALO before reaching the first safety car line.
rules_referenced: Article 39.8 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 99 Overtaking During A Safety Car Period
